name: Neel Shrivastava
headline: Biomedical Engineering (Bioinstrumentation & Electronics) + CS minor @ UW–Madison
summary: Biomedical engineering student at the University of Wisconsin–Madison studying bioinstrumentation and electronics, with a minor in computer science. I build at the intersection of hardware and software — from load-cell telemetry on 3D printers to SystemVerilog RTL and full-stack web apps. I care about creating systems that work in the real world, not just on paper.
